name: CodeRabbit API
desc: API and hosted MCP server for driving CodeRabbit from scripts and agents.
desc_zh: 让脚本和智能体调用 CodeRabbit 的 API 与托管 MCP 服务。
solves: Reviews could only be triggered by a git event; a CI job or an agent can now request one and wait for the result.
solves_zh: 过去只有 git 事件能触发审查；现在 CI 任务或智能体可以主动请求并等待结果。
best_for: Your pipeline needs a review verdict before it continues, not a comment that appears later.
best_for_zh: 流水线需要先拿到审查结论再往下走，而不是等一条稍后才出现的评论。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — docs.coderabbit.ai/changelog directory）。 Ships together with a hosted MCP server so agents such as Claude Code can read review threads. 首次公开日期来源：https://docs.coderabbit.ai/changelog
